title: A setting that settles
description: A slider gently catches at meaningful settings and springs into position.
useCase: Give a continuous control a few useful stops without hiding the values in between.
interaction: Drag the slider; use arrow keys or Shift + arrows
reducedMotion: The thumb goes directly to each value without spring travel or scale. Keyboard changes are also immediate.
limitations: This is a single-thumb horizontal control. Review value labels and detent spacing when adapting its range.
look: Pale sage-grey page with a label and value readout above a slim dark-green filled track, white-ringed rounded-square thumb and three small tick marks.
motion: Dragging snaps to detents within 4.5% of the range; fill and thumb follow on a spring (stiffness 520, damping 34) and the held thumb grows to 1.08.
adapt: `useSliderDetents` holds the snapping (`pull` defaults to 4.5% of range) and full keyboard map; the motion is `useSpring` with `CARRIAGE` feeding `x` via `useMotionTemplate`, plus the `GRAB` scale. Replace `DETENTS` with your stops and labels.
